During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''experimental handgun''' was developed to counter the [[Jedi killer]], a [[Jedi hunter]] that had traveled to [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, the weapon never saw use against the Jedi killer and it later came to be located within the [[Five Masters Academy]], a [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] [[school]] that was situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Fiend of shadow|shadowy being]] [[Destruction of the Five Masters Academy|attacked]] the Academy and massacred the students and [[Five Masters|instructors]]. [[Barnab Chistor]], a pupil of the Academy who had been absent during the early stages of the attack, witnessed the assailant engaging the [[Master in Violet]], the one member of the Academy's staff who was left alive, so he seized the experimental handgun and fired it at the being. A [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] from the device then struck the being, which forced the attacker to retreat.
